title: The shape of tail latency
description: Equal-width millisecond buckets show request counts against an optional SLO. Unknown buckets remain unavailable and never contribute a fabricated zero to the total.

props.name: data
props.description: Pre-aggregated counts in consecutive equal-width buckets. Counts must be safe nonnegative integers; null and invalid counts are unavailable. Buckets are half-open except the final upper boundary.

props.name: bucketWidthMs
props.description: Finite, positive width of every bucket in milliseconds.

props.name: startMs
props.description: Nonnegative lower boundary of the first bucket; defaults to zero.

props.name: objectiveMs
props.description: Optional nonnegative objective. Drawn at its exact position only when inside the bucket domain; no breach count is inferred from partially overlapping bins.

props.name: label
props.description: Console header label; the surrounding gallery or application owns its page title.

props.name: source
props.description: Caller-supplied source text in the footer.

props.name: window
props.description: Caller-supplied aggregation window or snapshot context in the footer.

props.name: updated
props.description: Caller-supplied freshness text; the component never invents live status.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional total width in pixels; otherwise fills the container.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total height in pixels. Dense plot content scrolls locally when constrained.

props.name: animate
props.description: Finite entrance animation using scoped motion tokens and the current reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional Tailwind utilities for the outer frame.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of this chart instance.
